Slave address when A0 pin is HIGH

register_map.notes: Pointer register selects one of four data registers via two LSBs.

access_model.notes: Pointer register must be written before read to select register.

steps.notes: Wait for conversion time (12-bit resolution typical 220ms) to ensure data ready.
Write pointer 0x00 to select Temperature Register, then read 2 bytes (MSB first).

operation_flows.notes: Standard read sequence for temperature with initial delay for conversion completion.

steps.notes: Write pointer 0x01 then one data byte to Configuration Register.
Write pointer 0x03 then two data bytes (MSB first) to THIGH Register.
Write pointer 0x02 then two data bytes (MSB first) to TLOW Register.
Write configuration with SD=1 and OS=1 to start single conversion.
Wait for conversion time (12-bit resolution typical 220ms).
Send General Call address (0x00) with R/W=0, then second byte 0x06 to reset device.
Small delay to allow device to reset and stabilize.

raw_encoding.notes: Temperature register: 2 bytes MSB first; lower 4 bits of LSB are zero.

registers_or_commands.name: Pointer Register
registers_or_commands.description: 8-bit register used to address data registers; two LSBs (P1,P0) select register. Power-up reset P1/P0=00.

registers_or_commands.name: Temperature Register
registers_or_commands.description: 12-bit read-only register storing most recent conversion output. Two bytes: MSB first, LSB second. Unused LSBs zero.

registers_or_commands.name: Configuration Register
registers_or_commands.description: 8-bit read/write register controlling operational modes. Bits: OS, R1, R0, F1, F0, POL, TM, SD. Power-up/reset all bits 0.

registers_or_commands.name: TLOW Register
registers_or_commands.description: 12-bit low temperature limit register. Two bytes: MSB first, LSB second. LSB byte bits D3-D0 zero.

registers_or_commands.name: THIGH Register
registers_or_commands.description: 12-bit high temperature limit register. Two bytes: MSB first, LSB second. LSB byte bits D3-D0 zero.

bitfields.name: OS
bitfields.description: One-Shot. Write 1 to start single conversion when in shutdown mode. Reads always 0.

bitfields.name: F1,F0
bitfields.description: Fault queue: number of consecutive faults to trigger alert. 00=1, 01=2, 10=4, 11=6.

bitfields.name: POL
bitfields.description: Polarity of ALERT pin: 0=active low, 1=active high.

bitfields.name: T11..T0
bitfields.description: 12-bit temperature data in two's complement format. MSB byte bits D7-D0 = T11..T4; LSB byte bits D7-D4 = T3..T0; LSB byte bits D3-D0 = 0.

bitfields.name: H11..H0
bitfields.description: 12-bit high limit value. MSB byte bits D7-D0 = H11..H4; LSB byte bits D7-D4 = H3..H0; LSB byte bits D3-D0 = 0.

bitfields.name: L11..L0
bitfields.description: 12-bit low limit value. MSB byte bits D7-D0 = L11..L4; LSB byte bits D7-D4 = L3..L0; LSB byte bits D3-D0 = 0.

init_sequence.notes: Power-up reset: Configuration Register all bits 0, Pointer Register P1/P0=00, Temperature Register reads 0°C until first conversion complete.
No explicit bus traffic required for initialization; device starts in continuous conversion mode (SD=0) with 12-bit resolution (R1,R0=11).

read_sequence.notes: Write pointer 0x00 to select Temperature Register, then read 2 bytes (MSB first).

timing_constraints.name: timeout_time
timing_constraints.condition: Typical timeout if SCL or SDA held LOW between START and STOP

inputs.name: raw
inputs.description: 16-bit Temperature Register value; lower 4 bits are zero.

error_conditions.condition: I2C NACK during address or data transfer
error_conditions.detection: Bus error; slave does not acknowledge

evidence_spans.snippet: The 8-bit Pointer Register of the devices is used to address a given data register.
Power-up reset value of P1/P0 is 00.
The Temperature Register of the TMP105 is a 12-bit, read-only register that stores the output of the most recent conversion.
The power-up/reset value of the Configuration Register is all bits equal to 0.
The TMP105 features one address pin allowing up to two devices to be connected per bus.
Data format for temperature is summarized in Table 5.
If the second byte is 00000110, the TMP105 will latch the status of the address pin and reset the internal registers to their power-up values.

requires_human: Power-up reset values for THIGH and TLOW registers are not explicitly given in the datasheet; need to determine from context or assume same as temperature register format.
The exact formula for temperature conversion is implied by resolution (0.0625°C per LSB for 12-bit) but not explicitly stated as a formula; confirmed by Table 5 examples.
